newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open barely changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open barely changed Monday as the New York market reopened after Friday's U.S. Independence Day holiday.
LME copper stocks rose 1,250 tonnes Monday to 131,100 tonnes.
September COMEX was last traded at 111.25 cents a lb on ACCESS, unchanged from Thursday's close.
LME trading Friday was subdued due to the U.S. holiday, with prices little changed from Thursday.
The LME cash to three months backwardation remained firm at $138/$142.
COMEX stocks Thursday fell 1,010 short tons to 42,576 short tons.
